title: A tidier Desk
summary: The Desk's Information cards now fit their content: six tiles side by side on a wide screen, and a swipe strip with dots on a phone. New campaigns get a short setup checklist.
items: On a computer, Session, Party, Funds, Market, Activity and Rolls show as a 3×2 grid of tiles, all visible at once.
On a phone, swipe the cards or tap the dots under them; the duplicate arrow pager is gone.
The Session tile names the current session and has End & start next (or Start session) right at the top.
A new campaign shows "Set up your campaign": add your party, a first place, a shop, a map and your players. Steps tick themselves, and the list can be hidden.
Empty readouts point to a next step ("Plan an encounter") instead of listing zeros.
